messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Outbound egress anomaly detected from auth-proxy-prod -> suspicious-collector.example.net:9000 (alert_id=AC-3348)

maria: I'm oncall, seeing the alert. spike in outbound connections from auth-proxy pods in us-west-2. investigating.

raj: checking VPC flow logs + k8s egress. multiple pods (auth-proxy-{a,b,c}) opened long-lived POSTs to 18.204.11.22:9000. headers show debug payloads. snippet: `POST /collect -> {"x-request-id":"...","authorization":"Bearer ..."}`

maria: whoops, looks like debug log level was set on the connector. those forwarded payloads include `Authorization` headers — potential exposure of session tokens. marking P0 for sec.

oliver (sec-eng): @maria tagging sec. This is a security privacy triage. Containment first: 1) block egress to 18.204.11.22 2) disable the log-forwarder connector 3) start key sweep for potentially leaked tokens.

maria: taking containment now. applying temporary networkpolicy to block egress from auth namespace. command: `kubectl apply -f deny-egress-auth-proxy.yaml` (running).

incident-bot: paging SRE oncall (pagerduty) -> sre-oncall (page_ts=3348001260)

sre-oncall: I'm paged and taking lead for infra containment. patching egress gateway to deny traffic to 18.204.11.22, rolling policy in 3 AZs.

raj: pushed reject rule to egress gateway: `aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry ...` (internal note: using egress-layer override). also disabled connector deployment: `kubectl rollout pause deployment/log-forwarder && kubectl scale deployment/log-forwarder --replicas=0`

jess: customer impact update: small subset of customers saw increased 401 errors during the window (12:03-12:08 UTC). no S3 buckets show signs of object downloads. telemetry shows session token mismatch errors.

oliver (sec-eng): start token sweep: list services for rotation: auth-proxy, session-api, analytics-ingest. owners: @maria auth-proxy, @raj session-api, @jess analytics-ingest. Follow runbook: rotate keys, revoke old tokens, issue short-lived replacements.

maria: kicking off rotation: `./scripts/rotate-service-keys.sh --services auth-proxy,session-api --batch-size=2` — will monitor for failed handoffs. posting progress in this thread.

sec-eng: collecting forensic artifacts now (pcap of egress, container logs, connector config). preserving pod images and configmaps. notifying legal/compliance via email.

maria: containment confirmed: egress to 18.204.11.22 blocked, connector scaled to 0. No new outbound attempts in last 120s.

incident-bot: incident AC-3348 status -> CONTAINED (mitigation: egress block + connector disabled)

sre-oncall: handing off to day team in 5m. @oliver please take post-mitigation lead, own the key sweep and RCA. I'll leave the egress rule in place until day eng signs off.

oliver (sec-eng): ack — taking ownership. timeline: containment at 12:06 UTC, key rotation start 12:08 UTC, forensic capture ongoing. will prepare customer notification draft and postmortem.

jess: drafting customer message: short note explaining transient auth disruptions, tokens rotated as precaution, no confirmed data exfil at this time. will share for review.

maria: thanks team. I'll follow up with rollout artifact that caused debug-level forwarding and add pre-deploy check to avoid shipping auth headers to external collectors.

incident-bot: next steps added to ticket AC-3348: [forensics], [key-rotation], [RCA], [customer-communication].

jess: :thumbsup:
